verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-3 diff remains correct and complete. The cron-minute map reads every scheduled workflow, rejects missing or unparseable inputs, and conservatively reserves minutes independent of wider cron fields. Its live-tree evidence is protected against thin-checkout vacuity by independent lane-set, lane-count, and nonempty-minute checks. Regate-sweep loads that single derivation, excludes only its own workflow, independently verifies its own parsed minutes, requires exact sparse-checkout membership for both the owner script and workflow directory, and fails its seam on load, parse, coverage, or collision errors. The moved :04/:24/:44 schedule avoids the previously hidden latch-watchdog overlap without colliding with another derived lane. The fixtures exercise full, partial, multi-lane, empty-map, missing-tree, and import-contract cases. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes.
